commands.purpose: Independent stdlib-only byte/hash verification and own-directory report metadata writes

commands.static_inspection: Prior cat, rg, sed, and nl commands are preserved exactly in tool transcript; no Git or candidate scripts executed. Reads above enumerate every file and exact byte/hash identity.

limitations: Retained behavior logs inspected, not rerun.
Chronology has no independent timestamp anchor.
scope: static/hash review only; no candidate code executed
